checks: Final application e9d605f (code through 2606b05) is integrated into test-audit. Nine defects are fixed, five remain open and D-G3-001 stays deferred. Evidence and release limitations: [final QA review](test-audit/release-review/REVIEW.md).
Combined suite: 1,746 passed, zero unexpected failures or skips, including 24 expected failures; 107.45 seconds. Evidence: [full suite](test-audit/release-review/full-suite.json).

Coverage suite: 1,746 passed in 120.2 seconds; configured thresholds pass. Statements 71.54%, branches 61.28%, functions 80.89%, lines 73.46%. Evidence: [coverage suite](test-audit/release-review/coverage-suite.json) and [summary](test-audit/release-review/coverage-summary.json).
Typecheck, lint and Knip exit 0 on the final QA tree. Lint retains 23 warnings. Both real CLI CI scenarios pass. Evidence: [static and CI checks](test-audit/release-review/static-ci-checks.json).

Both normal CLI/MCP import-persistence cases pass with unchanged assertions and direct caller-DB-omission fault kills. The variable-argument shell test now permits the exact constant dashboard command under the clarified ruling. It preserves shell-free transport checks without pinning incorrect path-only argv. Evidence: [context proofs](test-audit/release-review/release-context-mutations.results.json) and [extension proofs](test-audit/release-review/vscode.results.json).

All 24 remaining expected-failure cases fail as ordinary tests; source markers and application bytes were restored. D-VSC-001, DEF-G1-001, ADV-CTX-001, D-DASH-001 and ADV-FTS-001 remain OPEN. D-G3-001 remains DEFERRED. Evidence: [ordinary reproductions](test-audit/release-review/open-ordinary.json).

All 1,748 original declarations, 1,568 current declarations and 1,746 runtime cases reconcile with zero missing kills, survival proofs, unmapped cases or acceptance issues. Every original WEAK/HOLLOW classification retains surviving-fault or explicit structural evidence. Evidence: [ledger](test-audit/ledger.json) and [reconciliation](test-audit/reconciliation.json).

The final-source replay kills 26 application faults and 2 CI faults. Repeated identical context faults retain canonical IDs to avoid score inflation. Inverse repair unexpected passes receive no protection credit. The complete targeted score is 508/511, with 3 historical survivors visible. Evidence: [ID mapping](test-audit/release-review/mutation-id-aliases.json) and [ledger](test-audit/ledger.json).

All ten original KNOWN_DEFECT feature rows are restated from final evidence, retaining 41 feature groups and 164 obligations. Import persistence is now partial successful coverage; central FTS recovery remains a distinct known defect. Evidence: [feature restatus](test-audit/release-review/feature-restatus.json).

All six Docker setup scenarios pass against the final packed CLI using ephemeral tmpfs fixture directories with no network or host mounts. The default runner cannot create four fixtures because its disk is full. No data was deleted. Evidence: [default run](test-audit/release-review/docker.json) and [tmpfs replay](test-audit/release-review/docker-tmpfs.json).

Application bytes/modes match e9d605f; 29 explicitly listed application commits reproduce that tree from ec19554. The docs-only handoff commit is excluded from application patches. The original dirty checkout was not edited. Evidence: [source integrity](test-audit/release-review/source-integrity.json).

v584 config tests and the 50/100 ms read assertions remain byte-identical to ec19554 and pass. The coverage guard rejects missing base refs with exit 2; the local-storage workflow makes no network-share claim. Evidence: [unchanged tests](test-audit/release-review/unchanged-tests.json), [CI checks](test-audit/release-review/static-ci-checks.json), and [workflow review](test-audit/adversarial/ci-review.json).

Metadata generators were rerun and produced identical records. The strict application-acceptance guard rejected the docs-only commit until the manifest selected only actual application patches. Evidence: [metadata replay](test-audit/release-review/metadata-replay.json).

Behavior-over-implementation kept the real ID/signal contract separate from shell transport and preserved all persistence assertions. The configurable reconciliation script is the rerunnable mechanism for applying evidence from another approved application revision.

blockers.description: The automated suite has zero unexpected failures, but five open defects remain: D-VSC-001 selected-memory ID/signal handling, DEF-G1-001 routing reset, ADV-CTX-001 JSON config key disclosure, D-DASH-001 generated project-name click-handler injection, and ADV-FTS-001 central FTS recovery after table loss. D-G3-001 is explicitly deferred. These are documented release risks, not successful behavior.

The default Docker runner fails four fixture-directory creations with ENOSPC. The same final packed image and unchanged six tests pass with ephemeral tmpfs fixture directories. No Docker data was deleted; the ordinary local runner remains capacity-limited.

First-CI-run watchlist: src/test/phase7b.read-paths.test.ts:104 requires 100-memory reads below 100 ms; line124 requires FTS below 50 ms. Both thresholds are unchanged. Hosted contention and cold caches may exceed them.

Live provider credentials, native keychain/scheduler actions, native Windows/VS Code and physical network shares were not exercised. The 25 changed final application files were source-reviewed, but this bounded QA pass does not independently prove every class-sweep scenario in FIX_HANDOFF.md. Existing combined tests and named direct fault replays define the verified scope.
Local macOS Node 22.17.1 and the isolated Node 22 Docker image were exercised. No remote CI run, push, version bump, tag or publish was performed.

Unresolved coverage bases fail correctly. Added modules absent from coverage-summary remain skipped by the pre-existing scope rule; the pinned baseline check adds no application module and does not establish excluded-module coverage.
